batch.title: Messaging, private storage, and delivery workers
batch.goal: Complete conversations, unread and reply state, private attachments, broadcasts, reminders, outboxes, retry, dead letters, and delivery receipts.
exitCriteria: Private files reject public URLs and signed links expire or revoke as configured.
All scheduled workers expose idempotent retry, dead-letter, monitoring, and recipient delivery evidence.

findings.title: message-attachments bucket world-readable + getPublicUrl in inbox; site-map images public; zero org-scoped storage policies
findings.solution: Private buckets + signed URLs for chat/docs
acceptanceCriteria: Launch-critical workflow/security boundary works end-to-end with correct tenant scoping.
verificationRequirements: Unit/integration + seeded two-org persona test + API/DB evidence.

findings.title: Client-side Supabase writes bypassing API auth/audit: organizer_accounts settings update; inbox message inserts
acceptanceCriteria: Behavior is consistent, documented, tested and free of material integrity/usability/scale defect.

findings.title: Threads API hardcodes unreadCount:0 and ignores group threads; replies client-side
acceptanceCriteria: Behavior is consistent, documented, tested and free of material integrity/usability/scale defect.

findings.title: Broadcast = notification rows only; email depends on external DB webhook (503 if secret unset); event-reminders cron is a stub
findings.solution: Verify prod webhook config; implement reminders
acceptanceCriteria: Behavior is consistent, documented, tested and free of material integrity/usability/scale defect.

findings.title: Six music outbox workers are not scheduled or monitored
findings.solution: Register platform-internal schedules, bind service principals, make claims idempotent, add bounded retry/dead-letter handling, and expose internal health evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Every retained worker is scheduled or explicitly disabled; duplicate claims do not duplicate effects; failures become visible and recoverable.
verificationRequirements: Schedule inventory, service-principal authorization, duplicate-claim, retry, dead-letter, and monitoring tests.

specTasks.title: Reconcile source schemas
acceptanceCriteria: Calendar source fields/tenant keys match deployed migrations and canonical models; missing/failed sources appear as degraded, not empty.

specTasks.title: Enforce acting context and visibility
acceptanceCriteria: Calendar queries use signed active org, capabilities, source access, and protected-field projection; multi-org tests include guessed source IDs and feeds.

specTasks.title: Remove direct heterogeneous inserts
acceptanceCriteria: Calendar create/edit routes invoke event/task/staffing/hold/obligation commands with complete required context; partial placeholder rows cannot be created.

specTasks.title: Inventory notification/message paths
acceptanceCriteria: Every in-app/email/SMS/push/Work Mode/chat path has source, audience, dedupe/retry behavior, privacy class, owner, and convergence plan.

specTasks.title: Build canonical calendar read model
acceptanceCriteria: Stable source adapters and cursor/range query return authorized items with freshness/errors and avoid N+1/client fanout.

specTasks.title: Add calendar views and filters
acceptanceCriteria: Month/week/day/agenda and tour/stop/person/department/source/status/time-zone filters work accessibly on desktop/mobile; filters preserve scope.

specTasks.title: Add conflict overlays
acceptanceCriteria: Route, travel connection, shift overlap/rest, venue/production, equipment, obligation and deadline conflicts link to owning domain remediation.

specTasks.title: Add drag/edit command preview
acceptanceCriteria: Move/resize shows domain-specific interpretation, time zone, affected records/publications, validation and confirmation; unsupported source is read-only.

specTasks.title: Implement ICS snapshot/export
acceptanceCriteria: Stable UIDs/time zones/sequence/cancellations and audience projection pass common client tests; exports are audited and versioned.

specTasks.title: Implement subscription feeds
acceptanceCriteria: Scoped token creation/rotation/revocation/expiry, access log, rate limit/cache, minimal fields and permission-change behavior are complete.

specTasks.title: Define channel/audience model
acceptanceCriteria: Membership derives from canonical assignments/grants, supports named exceptions, re-evaluates access, and prevents cross-org discovery.

specTasks.title: Build unified inbox read model
acceptanceCriteria: Combines authorized messages, notifications, assignments, approvals and acknowledgements with source/type/priority/read/action filters and stable deep links.

specTasks.title: Route domain notifications through outbox
acceptanceCriteria: Domain transaction writes dedupe key/audience/event; provider processing is retryable and cannot send before commit or duplicate on retry.

specTasks.title: Add preferences and quiet hours
acceptanceCriteria: User/org mandatory-versus-optional rules, channel opt-in/consent, local quiet hours, digest, emergency override and audit are implemented.

specTasks.title: Add escalation/acknowledgement
acceptanceCriteria: Required action/version/deadline, reminders/escalation and recipient state are visible; dismissal/read does not equal acknowledgement.

specTasks.title: Secure attachments and links
acceptanceCriteria: Files and deep links reauthorize at access time; previews do not leak names/content; expired/revoked users lose access.

specTasks.title: Add calendar freshness/SLO monitoring
acceptanceCriteria: Per-source lag/error, query latency, feed token failure, invalid time zone and sync/client errors are measured and alerted.

specTasks.title: Add delivery observability
acceptanceCriteria: Queue age, provider failure, suppression/consent, duplicate prevention, open/ack rates, escalation backlog and dead letters are actionable.

specTasks.title: Test notification fatigue rules
acceptanceCriteria: Burst/digest/dedupe/quiet-hour/escalation tests prove critical messages arrive without repeated low-value notifications.

specTasks.title: Retire duplicate delivery paths
acceptanceCriteria: Work Mode, inbox, event groups and domain notifications use canonical audience/delivery status; legacy fire-and-forget writes are removed.

workflows.title: Messaging, Conversations, and Private Files

producer.outcome: Starts an authorized conversation, sends a message, or uploads an attachment.

recipients.outcome: Receives the message, unread state, reply context, and time-limited file access.

dataBoundaries.rlsExpectation: The authenticated sender is bound to auth.uid(); both participants and the object path are authorized; private files require scoped signed access.

workflows.recipientVisibleResult: Recipient receives one authorized message and can access attachments only until expiry.

recovery.retry: Retry is bounded, idempotent, and exposes the last failure.
recovery.reversal: A reviewed compensating or revocation command restores the prior safe state.
recovery.partialFailure: Partial effects remain visible and resumable; no silent success is returned.

workflows.title: Broadcasts, Reminders, Notifications, and Outbox Delivery

producer.outcome: Targets and sends an organization-scoped broadcast or reminder.

recipients.outcome: Receives the evaluated message once through the selected channel.
Claims, retries, or dead-letters delivery work.

dataBoundaries.rlsExpectation: Audience rows and worker claims retain organization scope; workers cannot accept caller-supplied actors.

workflows.recipientVisibleResult: Admin sees per-recipient delivery/retry state and recipients receive at most one logical message.

recovery.retry: Retry is bounded, idempotent, and exposes the last failure.
recovery.reversal: A reviewed compensating or revocation command restores the prior safe state.
recovery.partialFailure: Partial effects remain visible and resumable; no silent success is returned.

references.canonicalSource: Authenticated acting-context and capability command wrappers
invariants: Organization and actor context come from trusted server state.
Every mutation declares capability, target, validation, idempotency, audit, and stable errors.

references.canonicalSource: Shared Admin page header and explicit loading, empty, error, and permission states
invariants: Live Admin UI contains no mock or synthetic operational data.
Every surface provides accessible loading, empty, error, denied, success, and recovery behavior as applicable.

launchGates.title: Admin automated tests pass
launchGates.acceptance: All Admin suites pass with no unexplained skips.

launchGates.title: Two-organization RLS matrix passes
launchGates.acceptance: Positive and cross-organization negative cases pass for every exposed domain.

launchGates.title: Performance and reliability acceptance
launchGates.acceptance: Query budgets, retries, idempotency, observability, and failure recovery meet approved thresholds.
